tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List your sites with their site_key, tracking script and last-7-day pageviews.

tools.name: get_site_analytics
tools.description: Pageviews, visitors (humans), AI agent and bot requests, top pages and referrers for a period.

tools.name: get_site_summary
tools.description: A plain-language summary of the last 7 days with week-over-week change and highlights.

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Anomalies and trends: page spikes, new referrers, new AI agents, traffic drops, weekly trend.

tools.name: get_agents
tools.description: Every AI agent that fetched the site: operator, purpose (assistant, training, search), requests, top page.

tools.name: get_breakdown
tools.description: Top values of one dimension: path, referrer, source, channel, country, device, browser, os, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign or agent.

tools.name: get_live
tools.description: Visitors on the site now and the latest requests.

tools.name: get_agent_report
tools.description: Everything in one call: 7- and 30-day traffic, daily series, pages, referrers, channels, agents, insights, check-ins and recommended actions.

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: The last 30 days as a short Markdown document, for context windows.

tools.name: track_event
tools.description: Record a pageview: an agent's own visit, or a request your server forwards. Pass user_agent to classify a forwarded request; otherwise it counts as an AI agent visit under `agent` (default: the API key's name).

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Add a site. Returns its site_key and tracking script.

tools.name: log_checkin
tools.description: Record something you did to the site (published a post, deployed, changed a page) so it shows beside the traffic it caused.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a Measure account without a human. Starts a 14-day trial and returns an API key and tracking script; the billing contact is emailed a link to claim the account and add a card. No API key needed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "track_event" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Record a pageview: an agent's own visit, or a request your server forwards. Pass user_agent to classify a forwarded request; otherwise it counts as an AI agent …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_site_analytics" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get analytics data for a Measure.events site. Returns pageviews, top pages, and referrers for a given period." → after: "Pageviews, visitors (humans), AI agent and bot requests, top pages and referrers for a period."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
